note: Hook pattern ids an episode.spec may name. Universal; a world may add ids in <world>/hooks.json. Source: research/shorts_hooks.md section 2; all FOLK, no controlled studies.

reverse-open.what: start on the aftermath or the worst line, then rewind
reverse-open.fails_when: the aftermath is less funny than the build-up; spoils instead of teases

open-loop.what: a question or a half-confession the viewer wants closed

odd-image.what: a visually wrong first frame (wrong prop, wrong scale)
odd-image.fails_when: the image has no link to the joke

text-on-screen.what: a big 3-6 word line printed in frame 1
text-on-screen.fails_when: reading time over 1.5 s; collides with the UI overlay; repeats the voice

in-medias-res.fails_when: the viewer cannot tell who is who in 2 s

pattern-interrupt.what: silence then a loud shout; a hard cut
pattern-interrupt.fails_when: used every 2 s it becomes noise; one per video

standalone-line.what: open on the funniest sentence that works alone, spoken by 0.5 s
standalone-line.fails_when: the line needs context to be funny
